title: coord.py wait --timeout 1e308 through --url ends in an OverflowError traceback instead of exit 2
goal: SP-6jfnx5i3 review G7 (BG-as7rt42o, gate g1): finite() accepts a huge finite --timeout, and send() hands it on as the socket timeout, which overflows, so the client prints a traceback. A --timeout too large for the socket timeout is refused with exit 2 before any request.

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();k=os.path.join(d,'k');open(k,'w').write('x'*32)
p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--url','http://127.0.0.1:9','--key-file',k,'wait','--since','0','--timeout','1e308'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
print(p.returncode,p.stderr[-200:]);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==2 and 'Traceback' not in p.stderr else 1)

notes: SP-6jfnx5i3 2026-10-17: duplicates BG-gmaaoumg (SP-rsmmwzr2 review G4, the same OverflowError on a huge --timeout through --url); kept, not dropped, under the run's no-drop rule; the two are worked as one.
